On the ice [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], a group of [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolan]] colonists constructed an '''outpost''' in the side of [[Crescent Canyon]], and the colonists gave control of the outpost to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] when the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] arrived on-planet.
